description: Digital power factor controller (DCRG8 series). Values marked single/three phase depend on how the controller is wired and programmed
source: Lovato Electric, "DCRG8 Series Modbus Communication Protocol", doc. I432IGB05_20 (2020-05-20), tables 2-9; from firmware revision 4
notes: Lovato Electric DCRG8 digital power factor controller.
Addresses are as in the protocol tables; the wire address is one less.
FC06 and FC16 work only on addresses above 1000H.

registers.name: Total cos phi
registers.description: Signed long at 0000H whose high word is at the wrapped address FFFFH; this row reads the low word, exact for -1..1
registers.comment: Table 2 - measures (read with FC03 or FC04)

registers.name: Temperature
registers.description: °C or °F, as set on the device

registers.name: Max temperature
registers.description: °C or °F, as set on the device

registers.name: Output 1
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 2
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 3
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 4
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 5
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 7
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Output 8
registers.description: The protocol lists outputs from 2DF0H to 2DF7H; numbered here in order

registers.name: Alarm status
registers.comment: Table 6/7 - alarm status (unsigned long at 1400H: high word 1400H, low word 1401H)

registers.name: Event pointer
registers.description: Last event stored; write an event number (FC06) to select the record read at 5032H

registers.name: Event counter
registers.description: Total events stored (max 250)

registers.name: Event record
registers.description: 86 bytes: date (10), separator, time (12-19), separator, event text from byte 21

registers.name: Command
registers.description: After Setup to default or Restore parameters, send the reboot command (2F03H = 04)

registers.name: Step activation
registers.description: Write the number of the step to activate; ignored during its reconnection time

registers.name: Step de-activation
registers.description: Write the number of the step to de-activate

registers.name: Save
registers.description: Write 01 then 04 to store setup changes made over Modbus

registers.name: Parameter menu
registers.description: Step 1: menu number (e.g. 2 for M02)
registers.comment: Parameter access (menu, submenu, parameter, then value at 5004H)

registers.name: Parameter submenu
registers.description: Step 2: submenu, if the menu has one

registers.name: Parameter number
registers.description: Step 3: parameter number

registers.name: Parameter value (numeric < 32768)
registers.description: 1 register

registers.name: Parameter value (numeric >= 32768)
registers.description: 2 registers

registers.name: Parameter value (text, 20 characters)
registers.description: Text parameters use 3, 8 or 10 registers (6, 16 or 20 characters)
